decisions.reason: The designated source for correct author photos does not change the requirement to source article content from the publication website.
Correcting the source of author photos does not change the existing image-quality remediation rule.
The author-photo source correction does not alter the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The source of author photos does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The author-photo source correction does not change the deferred print-ready output format, resolution, or trim-and-bleed requirements.
